rationale: Although SNEX displays strong downward momentum, breaking to new session lows at $35.81 on elevated relative volume (3.37x) well below VWAP ($36.82) and the 5m 9-EMA ($36.42), the price is currently overextended by nearly 1.5 ATRs from the nearest structural resistance. Initiating a short directly at the session low with a 16.7 bps spread presents poor immediate risk-to-reward, especially given the portfolio is already heavily committed to the short side (68.7% of buying power). Mean-reversion long entry is likewise avoided as the most recent 1-minute candle shows expanding sell volume with no evidence of a bottoming base.
